_: npm run rig -- models/obito.rig.json. The source is an A-pose (arms ~50 deg down): `apose` lifts the arms into a T-pose first (its points are in the A-pose); everything else is measured on the T-posed mesh (TPOSE=out.glb npm run rig -- models/obito.rig.json writes it), in source units (facing +z, its left = +x, y up, feet at 0). scale 1.101 = the other bodies' size (hips 0.908 m, shoulders 1.25 m), so every character has the same hurtboxes.
name: Obito Uchiha

apose._: only the body mesh (material 0) has arms; the orbs (behind the back, and the two beside the hands) stay where they are (keep): on the hands they covered the face in the guard stance

islands._: the head mesh (face, hair, horns, eyes) follows the head; the Truth-Seeking orbs behind the back and the collar spikes are rigid on the upper chest, the two orbs beside the hands on the hips; the cloak (one piece with the torso and arms) is a coat below the waist; the pants and feet are legs

rigid._: the two orbs beside the hands float at the hips
orbs behind the back, collar spikes
